info.name: Gate Video Stream API
info.description: REST surface of the gate-video-stream service used by the web app to play back HLS playlists for hive entrance videos. Video upload and stream discovery are currently exposed through GraphQL.

item.name: Generate an HLS playlist for a hive entrance video stream

request.description: Returns a playlist assembled from stream segments stored by gate-video-stream. The playlist URL is normally obtained from the GraphQL `videoStreams` query and consumed by the web app video player.
